name: optical_sar_fusion
description: Joint optical+SAR land-cover extraction. Co-registers the pair via FFT phase-correlation, then compares classical spectral land-cover classification on the optical image against classical SAR backscatter-intensity thresholds on the SAR image, and reports water/vegetation/built-up regions where both modalities independently agree. Not a trained fusion model.

optical_image_path.description: Path to the co-registered optical/multispectral image

sar_image_path.description: Path to the co-registered SAR image, same area as the optical image

optical_landcover_pct.description: Land-cover class percentages from the optical image alone

sar_water_pct.description: Percentage of scene classed as water from SAR backscatter alone

sar_veg_pct.description: Percentage of scene classed as vegetation from SAR backscatter alone

sar_urban_pct.description: Percentage of scene classed as built-up from SAR backscatter alone

fused_water_pct.description: Percentage of scene both optical and SAR independently agree is water

fused_veg_pct.description: Percentage of scene both optical and SAR independently agree is vegetation

fused_urban_pct.description: Percentage of scene both optical and SAR independently agree is built-up

agreement_pct.description: Percentage of pixels where the optical and SAR classifications agree, across water/vegetation/built-up

fused_map_path.description: Path to a colour-coded map of the agreed water/vegetation/built-up regions

applied_shift_px.description: [dy, dx] pixel shift estimated and applied to co-register the SAR image onto the optical grid

summary.description: Natural language summary of the joint analysis
